body.prompt: Close-up inside a dark leather Roman command tent on the Danube at night, an iron brazier glowing orange, deep blue shadow: an older man's hand with a crimson sleeve raised palm-out in a quiet gesture of refusal, in the blurred background a kneeling soldier with a closed dark leather sack, nothing graphic. Not a painting, not an illustration. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame.
